limitations: Mandatory complete independent CPU shadow; no numerical geometry replacement
Four modes use one shared tight-compiled runner per fixture; anchor mode skips tight proof arithmetic, not a separately compiled historical v20 runner
Batched/round pairing changes only submission grouping and retains per-lane-round status/replay checkpoints
Compile/setup, full CPU shadow, renderer wall time, replay, readbacks and admission are reported separately
Descriptive software-adapter execution does not establish browser or physical-GPU performance

nativeDeviceReuse.scope: Test harness only; shared shader/pipeline/device setup, genuine per-scene buffers/bind groups/dispatch/readback/error scopes

decodedHistoryNegativeControls.scope: Synthetic decoded history at independent full-shadow admission boundary; not private GPU proof-state validation
